metadata.content: Spurs 2 - 3 Aston Villa - Match Report & Highlights Skip to main content Tottenham Hotspur vs Aston Villa; Premier League FT Full Time AET After Extra Time LIVE This is a live match. Tottenham Hotspur 2 C Gallagher ( 86' 86th minute ) J van Hecke ( 90+8' 98th minute ) Aston Villa 3 J Manzambi ( 45+4' 49th minute ) N Jackson ( 67' 67th minute ) E Buendia ( 79' 79th minute ) Latest Premier League Odds Get Sky Sports Get a NOW Sports Membership Watch Live Tottenham 2-3 Aston Villa: Roberto De Zerbi under pressure as winless Spurs drop into relegation zone Report as pressure ramps up on Roberto De Zerbi heading into the international break; Spurs are winless and sit in the relegation zone after five Premier League games Saturday 19 September 2026 14:40, UK Image: Emi Buendia leaps in celebration after scoring Aston Villa's third goal against Spurs Tottenham head into the international break without a win in the Premier League after losing 3-2 at home to Aston Villa. Roberto De Zerbi's expensively assembled side were hit by goals from Johan Manzambi, Nicolas Jackson and Emi Buendia which handed Villa an important win - their first of the season. Conor Gallagher at least got Spurs' first goal of the season late on, followed up by a Jan Paul van Hecke header, but it was nothing more than a consolation and too little too late. As it happened |
